text: Seafrigo is chaired by Seafrigo Investissements, a Le Havre SAS holding company (RCS Le Havre 909 922 965) whose president is Eric Barbe; the French registry lists no state or state-fund shareholder of the group.
short: Seafrigo is chaired by family holding Seafrigo Investissements (president Eric Barbe).

source.name: Pappers: SEAFRIGO INVESTISSEMENTS (909 922 965), Le Havre — extrait RNE

additionalSources.name: AJOT: Seafrigo becomes Principal Partner of Le Havre Athletic Club
additionalSources.quote: Seafrigo was created in Le Havre more than 40 years ago by Éric Barbé, and is deeply rooted in its home territory.
